in_hebrew.name: Eddie
in_hebrew.long_meaning: Eddie הוא שם נוצרי עם משמעות רוחנית עמוקה בתרבות הנצרות. Derived from the Old English name 'Eadweard' meaning 'wealthy guardian'. The name was popularized in the English-speaking world by the Anglo-Saxon King Eadweard the Great (Athelstan), who ruled from 871 to 939 AD.

in_greek.name: Eddie
in_greek.meaning: Χριστιανικό όνομα που σημαίνει wealthy guardian
in_greek.long_meaning: Eddie είναι ένα χριστιανικό όνομα με βαθιά πνευματική σημασία στον χριστιανικό πολιτισμό. Derived from the Old English name 'Eadweard' meaning 'wealthy guardian'. The name was popularized in the English-speaking world by the Anglo-Saxon King Eadweard the Great (Athelstan), who ruled from 871 to 939 AD.

in_latin.name: Eddie
in_latin.meaning: Nomen Christianum quod significat wealthy guardian
in_latin.long_meaning: Eddie est nomen Christianum cum profunda significatione spirituali in cultura Christiana. Derived from the Old English name 'Eadweard' meaning 'wealthy guardian'. The name was popularized in the English-speaking world by the Anglo-Saxon King Eadweard the Great (Athelstan), who ruled from 871 to 939 AD.
